## Step 7: Periodic Re-Verification  
### Risk-Based Re-Verification Schedule  
**Low-Risk Customers:**
- Re-verify every 5 years
- Reminder generated automatically in system
- May be waived if customer activity indicates no risk increase  
**Medium-Risk Customers:**
- Re-verify every 3 years
- Quarterly risk assessment (ongoing monitoring)
- Escalate if risk factors change  
**High-Risk Customers:**
- Re-verify annually
- Quarterly enhanced monitoring
- Transaction-by-transaction review for suspicious patterns
- Escalate for any risk changes  
**Triggering Immediate Re-Verification:**
- Customer registers new address
- Customer involvement in dispute/complaint
- Fraud detection/alert
- Regulatory query
- PEP status change
- Sanctions list hit

raw_entities.name: Periodic Re-Verification Process
raw_entities.description: A risk-based operational workflow to re-verify customer information at set intervals or upon specific triggers. The frequency of verification is determined by the customer's risk rating (Low, Medium, or High).

raw_entities.name: Low-Risk Customer Re-Verification
raw_entities.description: Re-verification of customers classified as low-risk occurring every 5 years. This process is initiated by an automatic system reminder and may be waived if no risk increase is indicated.
context: May be waived if customer activity indicates no risk increase

raw_entities.name: Medium-Risk Customer Re-Verification
raw_entities.description: Re-verification of customers classified as medium-risk occurring every 3 years. Includes ongoing monitoring via quarterly risk assessments.

raw_entities.name: High-Risk Customer Re-Verification
raw_entities.description: Annual re-verification for high-risk customers. This step involves quarterly enhanced monitoring and a transaction-by-transaction review to identify suspicious patterns.

raw_entities.name: Immediate Re-Verification Trigger Check
raw_entities.description: A decision gate that triggers an immediate re-verification process regardless of the scheduled cycle if specific event-based triggers occur, such as address changes or fraud alerts.

raw_entities.name: Automated System
raw_entities.description: The banking system responsible for automatically generating reminders for the re-verification of low-risk customers.

raw_entities.name: Low-Risk Customer
raw_entities.description: Customers classified as low-risk who are subject to a 5-year re-verification cycle.

raw_entities.name: Medium-Risk Customer
raw_entities.description: Customers classified as medium-risk who are subject to a 3-year re-verification cycle and quarterly assessments.

raw_entities.name: High-Risk Customer
raw_entities.description: Customers classified as high-risk requiring annual re-verification and enhanced monitoring.

raw_entities.name: Risk Classification Check
raw_entities.description: The control point where a customer's risk level (Low, Medium, High) is determined to assign the correct re-verification frequency and monitoring intensity.

raw_entities.name: Customer Address Update
raw_entities.description: The action of a customer registering a new address, which serves as a trigger for immediate re-verification.

raw_entities.name: Fraud Alert Trigger
raw_entities.description: A fraud detection event that necessitates the immediate re-verification of the customer's status.

raw_entities.name: Sanctions List Hit
raw_entities.description: A match found during sanctions screening that triggers an immediate re-verification process.
